phases.name: Parser Adapter Boundary
phases.goal: Create a parser-agnostic adapter boundary and wrap the current raw-text extractor without changing Quick Check behavior.

phases.name: Experimental Parser Adapters
phases.goal: Add one or more experimental parser adapters behind feature flags while keeping currentExtractor as the default fallback. Primary successful adapter: PyMuPDF (QUICK_CHECK_PARSER=pymupdf). Docling adapter is also registered (QUICK_CHECK_PARSER=docling) but remains optional/unavailable-safe; Docling installation is not required for Phase 0B completion.

phases.name: Parser Bakeoff Scorecard
phases.goal: Compare currentExtractor vs PyMuPDF adapter on frozen carbon PDFs using a JSON scorecard. Include Docling adapter only if available.

phases.name: Default Parser Switch Decision
phases.goal: Switch default parser only if the best experimental adapter beats currentExtractor and strict evals remain safe.

phases.name: Evidence Compiler v2
phases.goal: Use better parser structure to improve canonical EvidenceDocument spans.

phases.name: Family-Aware ProjectFactContract v2
phases.goal: Improve project title, host country, and methodology extraction using document-family-aware rules.

phases.name: Hierarchical Section + Table Index
phases.goal: Use parser-preserved hierarchy and table structure to improve section and table retrieval.

phases.name: Evidence Sufficiency Validators
phases.goal: Require check-specific evidence sufficiency before returning answered.

phases.name: Eval Corpus + CI Gate
phases.goal: Lock parser and evidence improvements into CI with strict evals and no fake-answer regressions.
